en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone fountain in a small European square. The fountain has a tall, decorated pedestal with lion-head spouts and a seated female figure on top, posed in a contemplative manner. Surrounding it are old multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and cobblestone pavement. Along the bottom border, handwritten-style text identifies the location.
